entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your creator was a priest and magician, and your memories are filled with the smell of incense.

Prerequisite(s): Shabti.

Benefit(s): You gain Spellcraft as a class skill. Whenever you attempt a Spellcraft check, you can roll twice and take the better of the two results.
